# hpe_morpheus_os_type (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_os_type" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_os_type" "example" {
  name = "Example name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Morpheus ID of the OS type
- `name` (String) The name of the OS type

### Read-Only

- `bit_count` (Number) The architecture bit count (e.g. 32 or 64)
- `category` (String) The category of the OS type
- `cloud_init_version` (String) The version of CloudInit being used
- `code` (String) The code Morpheus uses as an internal identifier
- `description` (String) The description of the OS type
- `images` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))
- `install_agent` (Boolean) Whether to install the Morpheus agent on provisioned instances
- `os_codename` (String) The codename of the OS type
- `os_family` (String) The family of the OS type
- `os_name` (String) The OS name of the OS type
- `os_version` (String) The OS version of the OS type
- `owner` (String) The owner  of the OS type
- `platform` (String) The platform of the OS type (e.g. linux, windows)
- `vendor` (String) The vendor of the OS type

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `account` (Number)
- `compute_zone_type` (Number)
- `id` (Number)
- `provision_type` (Number)
- `virtual_image_id` (Number)
- `virtual_image_name` (String)
- `zone` (Number)
